scope: Read-only browser-local fault injection of one native catalog GraphQL response entry. No resource creation or mutation submission. Real upstream catalogs succeeded.
receiptBoundary: Each fault preserves the exact selected native request, complete corresponding native response entry and complete synthetic replacement entry, plus native batch operation names and unchanged sibling count. Unrelated sibling bodies are omitted from this durable evidence; they were preserved unchanged by the probe. Healthy controls preserve complete selected operations and entries. DOM/ARIA receipts are projections, not entire browser state.
